riskHeadline: Board confidence is getting ahead of booking evidence because attribution still forks too easily across the AI lane.
breakageSignal: Executive briefings, policy packets, and operator surfaces point to traction, but pipeline evidence still lands in too many parallel systems.
blockingIssue: One commercial outcome still has to be reconciled across CRM notes, board memos, and platform narratives.

riskHeadline: Deals are getting delayed by procurement pressure without one consistent way to quantify the revenue exposure.
breakageSignal: Commercial teams can feel the drag, but the revenue system still does not tag proof-room effort, questionnaire burden, and close-delay outcomes in one place.
blockingIssue: Trust work is helping, but not all related revenue events are coded consistently enough to make the savings and acceleration story board-ready.

riskHeadline: Leaders can see the regulated proof, but not always the clean revenue-throughline from evidence surface to booked opportunity.
breakageSignal: Quality, CAPA, specimen, and GxP work all look strong independently, yet still report through too many adjacent narratives.
blockingIssue: The lane needs one tighter commercialization rollup instead of four separate proof surfaces that require manual synthesis.

riskHeadline: The lane is winning attention, but control failures are still leaking money and trust.
breakageSignal: Merchant review, reconciliation, and treasury logic do not yet reconcile into one clean revenue protection packet.
blockingIssue: One control failure still creates too many downstream mismatches between payout, finance, and risk reporting.

riskHeadline: The lane can look healthier than it is because forecast confidence is still built on fragmented signals.
breakageSignal: Grant evidence, donor stewardship, and outcomes work all point in the same direction, but not through one standardized forecast model.
blockingIssue: The current motion still needs one cleaner tie between operator demand, renewal probability, and realized revenue timing.

riskHeadline: The board can see the vision, but not yet enough control proof to trust the revenue case fully.

blockingIssue: The lane still needs one stronger evidence path between technical range and board-safe revenue confidence.
